summary: Pinned the three advisory repo-health signals named in this task to committed, keyed, ratchet-only baselines and wired each gate to fail on an increase, with every new ENFORCE_* flag defaulting to 1. README verification dates (scripts/readme-date-baseline.txt), C20's residual/unverifiable-declaration/unverifiable-filename sub-counts (scripts/c20-residual-baseline.txt), and C16's widened env_linter sweep (scripts/c16-roots-baseline.txt, via the new scripts/c16_roots_baseline.py generator/gate) are each enforced. All six seeded falsification arms (two README, three C20, one C16-roots) were observed to fail with a printed FAIL line and a non-zero exit, then pass again after reverting the seed. One root (BimodalToolsTest) is excused from C16-roots measurement via a new scripts/c16-roots-unmeasurable.txt, loudly, because its own build fails for a pre-existing, separately-owned reason unrelated to env_linter.

artifacts.summary: Full account of all six phases, the decisions made, the plan deviations, and the consolidated six-arm falsification record.
